acceptanceCriteria: Each dogfood-event-unavailable degradation carries a stable cause code.

body: user-prompt events most often degrade as dogfood-event-unavailable, separately from dogfood-event-deadline (69 windows). The tally does not say why the event was unavailable (no enrollment, store lock, index stale, subprocess refused). Report a cause code with each unavailable degradation and remove avoidable causes; relates to V1-1496 (measured deadline cause) and V1-1524 (dirty projection paths). Evidence: `corvint observations` in ~/projects/corvint on 2026-10-19 (Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 668, Claude Code plugin corvint@corvint 0.3.1).
